source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DL100, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « Using 4 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 and carefully designed circuits, its performance reaches an unprecedented level of 0.00009 %(-120dB) non-weighting distortion; »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports PCM up to 32bit/768kHz and DSD up to DSD256; »; « There are two modes to choose from: USB 1.1 and USB 2.0; »; « Bluetooth 5.1 digital audio input, external antenna, longer transmission distance; »

facts.chip: Four Cirrus Logic CS43131 (« Using 4 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_USB_1_1_mode_lowers_the_ceiling: « USB 1.1 and USB 2.0 » modes: the ceiling recorded is the USB 2.0 one; no figure is given for USB 1.1.
